props.claim: A task is added from a typed task title when the user presses Enter.
Clicking a checkbox marks a task complete.
Completed tasks use a strikethrough style.
Deleting a task is triggered by clicking an "x" control on the task.
Each task card shows a small priority badge and the rest of the card UI, controls, and layout stay unchanged.
Priority values are High, Medium, and Low, and the default is Medium.
